description: Sends the eng workflow contract and the core writing rules at session start and after each compaction, tells you on a new session which of eng's settings, tools and permission rules are missing, and adds a few categorical guards: no comment, review or reply is posted; every remote write the hook finds from a subagent is denied: a shell command's, a post through any MCP tool, and any other MCP write whose name shows it, a tracker's included, apart from well-known servers that run on this machine; merges, releases, deploys, force pushes other than one with an explicit lease that names no default branch on either side, and other writes that are hard to take back ask first, while commits, pushes, PRs and issues are left to Claude Code's own permissions; code-review never runs with --comment or --post, and the model never runs it with --fix or ultra; and changed code that has not been reviewed gets one reminder before hand-back.
